lines.text: Your documents deserve a better home.
Meet DocBro. A fast, native word processor for Mac, Windows and Linux.
Open Word and Markdown files, and save them back, exactly as they were laid out.
Type slash to insert anything. Headings, tables, images. Nothing gets in your way.
And your AI is already in the room. DocBro runs its own MCP server, so Claude, Cursor and Codex can read and edit your document, live, while you watch.
Every AI edit is one undo step. You stay in control.
DocBro. Write with your AI, not around it.
